column1: Pound the chicken to an even thickness and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat and brown the chicken 7–8 minutes, flipping halfway. It doesn't need to be cooked through. Set aside covered with foil.
Off the heat, add the broth, lemon juice, zest, onion, garlic, and thyme to the skillet. Return to medium-high heat and scrape up the browned bits.
Boil uncovered about 10 minutes until reduced to roughly 1/2 cup.
Stir in the cream and butter and simmer 3–4 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Nestle the chicken into the sauce and bake about 10 minutes until it reaches 165°F (74°C).
Serve with sauce spooned on top and garnish with lemon slices and thyme if desired.
